08
Grammar Focus

The -ing Form

动名词 · A verb wearing a noun's clothes. This one small ending appears seven times in today's text.
L20Grammar 1
Grammar 1 · 介词 + 动名词

After a Preposition

preposition+verb-ing

The rule

A preposition can only be followed by a noun. To put a verb there, we turn it into a noun with -ing. Never use to + verb after a preposition.

withoutinstead ofafterbeforeininterested ingood atfond of

From the text

I often fish for hours without catching anything.我经常钓上几个小时却什么也钓不到。
Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots.他们钓到的不是鱼，而是旧靴子。
I'm not really interested in fishing.我其实对钓鱼并不感兴趣。
10
L20Grammar 2
Grammar 2 · 动词 + 动名词

After Certain Verbs

give up · enjoy · mind · finish…+verb-ing

The rule

Some verbs are always followed by -ing, not to. Learn them as a family — they are favourites in 中考 multiple-choice questions.

give upenjoymindfinishkeep (on)practiseavoidcan't help

Examples

"You must give up fishing!" my friends say."你必须放弃钓鱼！"朋友们说。
He enjoys sitting by the river. enjoys to sit他喜欢坐在河边。
Would you mind closing the window?你介意关上窗户吗？
11
L20Grammar 3
Grammar 3 · 动名词作主语 & 完成式

As a Subject — and "having done"

Verb-ing+is / was …·after+having + done

The rule

An -ing form can be the subject of a sentence, and it takes a singular verb.

Having + past participle shows the action was finished before the main action — "after having spent" = after he had spent.

From the text

Fishing is my favourite sport.钓鱼是我最喜爱的运动。
Sitting in a boat and doing nothing makes me happy.坐在船上什么也不做让我很开心。
After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.在河上待了整整几个上午后，我总是背着空包回家。

The Text

One Man
in a Boat

Read sentence by sentence. The bright line is in focus — find the -ing form and say why it is there.
L20Check
Comprehension · 理解

Did You Get the Joke?

1What do unlucky fishermen catch instead of fish?
Old boots and rubbish.
2What does the writer catch?
Nothing at all — not even old boots. He always goes home with an empty bag.
3What do his friends tell him? Why?
"You must give up fishing! It's a waste of time." — because he never catches anything.
4What is the "one important thing" they don't realize?
He isn't really interested in fishing. He is only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!

"You must give up fishing!" — What does give up mean?
Q1REVIEW
A
start
✗
B
enjoy
✗
C
stop doing something
✓

Correct — give up = stop. Notice the form: give up fishing, never give up to fish. Exactly what we learned today.
06
Which sentence is correct?
Q2REVIEW
A
I fish for hours without to catch anything.
✗
B
I fish for hours without catch anything.
✗
C
I fish for hours without catching anything.
✓
D
I fish for hours without caught anything.
✗
Yes — after a preposition (without, instead of, in, after…) a verb takes the -ing form. 介词后面的动词用 -ing。
